project.title: Bacterial breath & skin microbiomes of managed & free-ranging killer whales in western North America
project.description: Breath & skin samples from managed & free-ranging resident & transient killer whales in western North America were analyzed for bacterial microbiomes by sequencing 16S microbial amplicons. Objectives were to 1) characterize the bacterial & archaeal communities from those samples; 2) identify shared microbial taxa for breath and for skin; and assess community patterns for usefulness in individual animal health assessments.
